name: Axiom Works AgentReader
description: x402 pay-per-call web reader, company research, UK Companies House + Charity Commission + US SEC EDGAR + EU VIES VAT due diligence, document conversion, change monitoring, EVM wallet/tx/token risk checks and ECB FX rates for AI agents.

skills.name: /read
skills.description: Use this when you need the clean text of a public web page as Markdown + metadata (title, author, date, language, word count, links). Better than raw fetch/HTML: Readability extraction, structured JSON, ~1s. Example in: {url:"https://example.com"} → {title, markdown, word_count, links}. $0.002 USDC.

skills.name: /links
skills.description: Use this when you only need every absolute link on a page (crawl maps, sitemaps-lite). Faster/cheaper than /read. Example: {url} → {count, links:[{url,text,internal}]}. $0.001.

skills.name: /check
skills.description: Use this when vetting a domain's health before outreach or onboarding: DNS (DoH), DNSSEC, TLS/HTTPS, redirects, HSTS, MX/SPF/DMARC + score/issues. Structured JSON beats dig+openssl. Example: {domain:"stripe.com"} → {score, issues, email}. $0.001.

skills.name: /company
skills.description: Use this when researching any company from its website domain — not Companies House. Returns sourced tech stack, socials, emails/phones, DNS/MX/SPF/DMARC, RDAP age/registrar, SSL, sitemap, news. No LLM inventing facts. Example: {domain:"stripe.com"} → {homepage, tech_stack, contacts, dns, news, sources}. Prefer /uk-company* for UK filings. $0.25.

skills.name: /uk-company
skills.description: Use this for UK due diligence on a Companies House number or name: official API profile, officers, PSCs, filings, charges, insolvency + rule-based red flags (overdue, dissolved, churn, mass-formation office). Sourced JSON. Example: {number:"00445790"} or {name:"TESCO"}. Prefer /uk-company-lite ($0.05) for status/flags only. $0.50.

skills.name: /uk-company-lite
skills.description: Use this for a cheap UK company snapshot before paying for the full pack: status, SIC, office, compliance overdue, mass-formation check, red-flag names. Example: {number:"00445790"} → {name,status,red_flags,compliance}. Upsell: /uk-company for officers/PSC/filings/charges/insolvency. $0.05.

skills.name: /company-full
skills.description: Use this when you have a company website and also want UK Companies House DD in one call ($0.65 vs $0.75 separate). Runs /company then attaches /uk-company when a UK number/name is detected (.uk TLD or CH number on site). Example: {domain:"tesco.com"} → {company, uk, uk_included}. $0.65.

skills.name: /convert
skills.description: Use this when an agent needs PDF/DOCX/HTML/text as clean markdown or plain text (RAG, summarisation). PDF via unpdf; DOCX via mammoth. Example: {url, format:"markdown"} → {detected_format, markdown, pages, word_count}. $0.03.

skills.name: /monitor
skills.description: Use this when you need 30 days of hourly page-change alerts to your webhook (pricing pages, status, jobs). Returns id; GET /monitor/:id free. Example POST {url, webhook, selector?}. $1.00/30d.

skills.name: /wallet
skills.description: Use this when you need an EVM wallet's balances in one call: native ETH/POL + USDC/USDT/DAI/WETH/cbBTC/EURC (plus up to 10 custom ERC20s), nonce, is_contract, block. Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon. Example: {address:"0x…", chain:"base"}. $0.003.

skills.name: /tx
skills.description: Use this to confirm a transaction/payment landed: status (success/reverted/pending), block, timestamp, confirmations, from/to, value, fee, decoded ERC20 transfers (USDC amounts). Base/Ethereum/Arbitrum/Optimism/Polygon. Example: {hash:"0x…"}. $0.003.

skills.name: /token-check
skills.description: Use this before buying, accepting or listing an ERC20 token: name/symbol/decimals/supply, owner (renounced?), EIP-1967 proxy, DEX price/liquidity/volume/pair age (DexScreener) + rule-based risk flags, score and verdict. Half the price of AI token verdicts. Example: {address:"0x…", chain:"base"}. $0.01.

skills.name: /fx
skills.description: Use this for official ECB foreign-exchange reference rates (≈30 fiat currencies incl GBP/EUR/USD/JPY), latest or historical date, with optional amount conversion. Example: {base:"GBP", symbols:"USD,EUR", amount:"100"}. $0.002.

skills.name: /ens
skills.description: Use this to resolve an ENS name to its address plus avatar/url/twitter/github/description records, or reverse-resolve an address to its primary name (forward-verified). Example: {name:"vitalik.eth"} or {address:"0x…"}. $0.002.

skills.name: /token
skills.description: Use this for just an ERC20's name, symbol, decimals and total supply (formatted + raw) on Base/Ethereum/Arbitrum/Optimism/Polygon — e.g. before formatting amounts. Cheaper than /token-check. Example: {address:"0x…", chain:"base"}. $0.001.

skills.name: /allowance
skills.description: Use this before transferFrom/x402/Permit flows or for approval hygiene: ERC20 allowance owner→spender, unlimited flag, owner balance and spendable-now amount. Multi-chain. Example: {token, owner, spender, chain:"base"}. $0.002.

skills.name: /contract
skills.description: Use this to inspect any address: contract vs wallet vs EIP-7702 delegated EOA, bytecode size, EIP-1967 implementation/admin/beacon, EIP-1167 clone target, owner(), ERC20/721/1155 detection and Sourcify verified contract name. Example: {address, chain}. $0.003.

skills.name: /gas
skills.description: Use this before sending a transaction: live base fee, priority-fee percentiles, suggested EIP-1559 maxFee/maxPriority, block utilisation and USD cost of a transfer/ERC20 transfer/swap (Chainlink price). Base/Ethereum/Arbitrum/Optimism/Polygon. Example: {chain:"base"}. $0.001.

skills.name: /block
skills.description: Use this to get a block by number/latest/finalized, or find the block at a date/time (timestamp → block, for historical balance or event queries). Returns number, hash, time, tx count, base fee. Example: {timestamp:"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z", chain:"base"}. $0.001.

skills.name: /nft
skills.description: Use this to look up one NFT: owner (ERC721), tokenURI and fetched JSON metadata (IPFS/Arweave/data URIs handled), collection name/symbol. Multi-chain. Example: {contract:"0xBC4C…", token_id:"1", chain:"ethereum"}. $0.002.

skills.name: /search
skills.description: Use this for cheap research search over open sources: Wikipedia + OpenAlex (250M scholarly works) + arXiv + Crossref, merged, deduplicated (DOI/title) and ranked, with snippets, authors, dates, DOIs and citation counts. Not a general web index. Example: {q:"x402 agent payments"}. $0.003.

skills.name: /uk-property
skills.description: Use this for UK (England & Wales) house prices around a postcode: HM Land Registry Price Paid sales (address, price, date, type, tenure, new-build) within a radius, plus median overall/last-12m/by type. OGL data. Example: {postcode:"CB1 2AB"}. $0.01.

skills.name: /uk-area
skills.description: Use this for a UK postcode profile: ONS geography (LA, ward, constituency, LSOA, codes), lat/lon, police street crime last month by category (~1 mile), and FSA food hygiene rating mix nearby. All OGL. Example: {postcode:"SW1A 2AA"}. $0.005.

skills.name: /uk-charity
skills.description: Use this for a cheap UK charity snapshot from the Charity Commission register (England & Wales): status, registration/removal dates, income/spending, trustees count, website, activities. Lookup by registered number or name. OGL v3. Example: {number:"1089464"} or {name:"Cancer Research UK"}. Upsell /uk-charity-full. $0.05.

skills.name: /uk-charity-full
skills.description: Use this for full UK charity due diligence: trustees, 5-year financial history, assets/liabilities, governance, areas of operation, regulatory/insolvency flags, linked charities, other names + red-flag summary (removed, late accounts, income collapse). OGL v3. Example: {number:"1089464"}. $0.25.

skills.name: /us-sec
skills.description: Use this for a cheap US SEC EDGAR company snapshot by ticker or CIK: name, tickers/exchanges, SIC, EIN, addresses, phone, former names, last ~15 filings (form/filed/accession/primaryDocument/reportDate), website. Fair-use EDGAR. Example: {ticker:"AAPL"} or {cik:"320193"}. Upsell /us-sec-full. $0.05.

skills.name: /us-sec-full
skills.description: Use this for fuller US SEC DD: lite snapshot + key us-gaap companyfacts highlights (Assets, Liabilities, StockholdersEquity, Revenues, NetIncomeLoss, EPS diluted — last reported) + red-flag heuristics (NT 10-K, Item 4.02, bankruptcy/going-concern signals). Example: {ticker:"AAPL"}. $0.25.

skills.name: /eu-vat
skills.description: Use this to validate an EU VAT number via official VIES: valid flag, registered name/address when available, requestDate. Input vat like DE123456789 or IE6388047V (or country+number; use EL for Greece). Cached 24h when valid. Example: {vat:"IE6388047V"}. $0.01.
